statements.claim: The TDV encyclopaedia survey lists a silver Bosna muharebesi madalyası under 1294 (1877).
The historical Ottoman awards table lists Bosna Madalyası under 1270 and assigns 1294 to Karadağ and Rusya Muharebesi medals, not a separate Bosnia award.
The five-page museum inventory lists the older Bosnia medal and later Russia/Plevna medals but no separate 1877 Bosnia object.
Complete scans of Künker 299 lots 7001-7448 and the 158-page ITU Ottoman medals catalogue produced no independently identifiable 1877 Bosnia medal.

decision: Remove this item from the ordinary unpictured queue. Retain it only as a conflict candidate until a decree, object, or specialist catalogue independently demonstrates a distinct 1877 Bosnia medal. Do not merge it silently with the documented 1850 Bosnia family and do not fabricate a variant row.
